sharedRisk: Week of 19 Oct: Tesla reports Wed 21 Oct after the US close (options price a ±7.4% move). Fed decision Wed 28 Oct, with a hike back on the table after September CPI came in at 3.7% (core 2.6%). Chip stocks fell 11% last week on AI-financing worries (CoreWeave bonds), a five-month high in oil ($102) and yields above 5%, even though TSMC guided Q4 up 58% y/y. Monday was a bounce, not yet a turn. 10-year 5.14%, Brent $109, VIX 18. The detailed sections below (snapshot, technicals, ranges, setups) are from the 9 Oct edition; the Latest close and Plan sections are current. Model estimates, not a guarantee.

It sits exactly on the 50-day ($538.23); the 100-day is $526. RSI 40. MACD histogram −14.9, still falling. The fastest-rising stock of the three is also the one hit hardest when AI financing is questioned.
To Friday (implied vol ≈ 56%): 68% range $501–577. Odds: touch $560 ≈ 57%; close below $526 ≈ 37%; touch $506 ≈ 38%.
Earnings 3 Nov. Price targets ($700–800) are unchanged, but the chart says wait.
stocks.keyPoint: How stretched it is (2.5 ATR above the 20-day) against a falling MACD histogram.
technicals: Daily and weekly trend up. Moving averages stacked bullishly; weekly closes 516 → 560 → 631 → 634 → 646.
6 Oct high of 658.52 came on 24.2M shares (1.1×) with a wide 628–658.5 candle that closed mid-range. Volume fell to 0.83× the next day.
Momentum conflict: price made a higher high while the MACD histogram fell six days in a row (6.48 → 2.90) and RSI stayed ≈ 70. A bearish momentum divergence: the move is slowing, not reversing.
Realized vol over 10 days (31%) is well below 60-day (63%), and implied (~48%) is rich vs realized. Options traders are paying for a move.

Backtest disagrees with 'overbought means pullback': in 86 cases since 2016 with AMD 7–14% above its 20D and RSI 65–78, median return was +1.3% after 5 days (62% up) and +3.5% after 10 days (62% up), range −23% to +23%.
Net: drift still up, but stretch and fading momentum make a dip toward 600–630 likely before a move to 700.
